base.text: When any player ends a turn with unspent mana: Summon an X/X Bread Token for you. X = that player's unspent mana.

radiant.text: When any player ends a turn with unspent mana: Summon an X/X Bread Token for you. X = 3 × that player's unspent mana.

base.text: When your opponent plays a (1) Cost or less card, if you have an empty unit zone: Summon 2 Rush Tokens. If it's a Unit, they attack it.

radiant.text: When your opponent plays a card, if you have an empty unit zone: Fill your board with Rush Tokens. If it's a Unit, they attack it.

base.text: Deal 2 damage to a target, +1 per full 5 health your hero is below 30, +1 per card in your exile.

radiant.text: Deal 4 damage to a target, +1 per full 3 health your hero is below 30, +2 per card in your exile.

base.text: When your opponent plays a permanent of a type you control: Fuse it onto a random permanent of yours of that type.

radiant.text: When your opponent plays a permanent of a type you control: Fuse it onto every permanent of yours of that type.

base.text: When your opponent declares an attack that would be lethal to your hero: Cancel it. The rest of their turn is played at random.

radiant.text: When your opponent declares an attack that would be lethal to your hero: Cancel it and destroy the attacker. The rest of their turn is played at random.

base.text:
Cry: Exile all other permanents.
Costs (1) less for each card drawn, played, destroyed or exiled this game.

Cry: Exile all other permanents.
